content.text:
=== Does Navigation.vue reference AppSidebar/NavUser/AppShell? ===
NO - Navigation.vue does NOT import the missing components

=== What imports NavUser.vue? ===
resources/js/components/AppSidebar.vue

=== What imports AppSidebar.vue / AppHeader.vue (layouts)? ===
resources/js/layouts/app/AppSidebarLayout.vue
resources/js/layouts/app/AppHeaderLayout.vue
resources/js/layouts/AppLayout.vue

observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== Does Navigation.vue reference AppSidebar/NavUser/AppShell? ==="; grep -nE 'AppSidebar|NavUser|AppShell|AppHeader|UserInfo|UserMenuContent' resources/js/components/Navigation.vue || echo "NO - Navigation.vue does NOT import the missing components"; echo; echo "=== What imports NavUser.vue? ==="; grep -rln "NavUser" resources/js --include='*.vue' --include='*.ts'; echo; echo "=== What imports AppSidebar.vue / AppHeader.vue (layouts)? ==="; grep -rln "AppSidebar\|AppHeader" resources/js --include='*.vue' --include='*.ts'
